newsitem.title: UK: Whitehead Mann Plc shares set debut premium.
newsitem.headline: Whitehead Mann Plc shares set debut premium.

text.p: Shares in Whitehead Mann, an executive recruitment company specialising in high level appointments, set a premium on their first day of trade on London Stock market on Wednesday.
By 1120 GMT the company's shares were quoted at 144-1/2p, ahead of their 136p issue price, with a trading volume of 100,736 shares.

At the issue price Whitehead Mann, which said it had a large number of blue chip clients in a wide range of industrial and commercial areas, was valued at 21.1 million stg. A company spokesman said Whitehead raised no new money with the issue.
The company said the listing would enable it to provide greater incentives to staff through share schemes and that it would raise the group's profile.
The float would also provide liquidity through a wider shareholder base and allow selective acquisitions to be made, Whitehead Mann said.
